build.message: Return only JSON with one string property named html. Build a very simple meeting-cost calculator as one complete HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript. No tools, packages, network calls, external resources, links or imports. Use a dark background, orange accent, system fonts, visible labels and keyboard focus, and a layout that fits 390px. Inputs: attendees (integer >= 1), duration in minutes (finite >= 0), hourly rate in CAD (finite >= 0). Defaults 4, 30, 150 show $300.00. Formula: attendees * minutes / 60 * rate. Update automatically on input; 60 minutes shows $600.00. Include Reset to defaults. No Calculate button. Reject blank, negative, nonfinite and fractional attendee values with visible errors and no stale total, NaN or Infinity. Use Intl.NumberFormat en-CA currency CAD with two decimals. Show a clear error if the calculation overflows. Keep the code short and basic; leave review and decisions to the coordinator. Do not delegate or describe tests you did not run.
